example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পিতলা শখ রাখতে কোনো লাভ নেই।
এই পিতলা শখ ছেড়ে দাও, কিছু হবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: There's no point in pursuing his worthless hobby.
Give up this foolish whim; it won't lead anywhere.
note: The idiom contrasts brass (cheap metal) with more valuable materials, implying superficial or unproductive interests.
